name: The Trophy
tagline: Engraved "Well done." That's all it says.
summary: A trophy cup on a wooden base, engraved "Well done." The engraving cannot be changed. Gold, 20 cm tall. £24.
concept: A cup on a stem, on a solid base, with a plate engraved "Well done." It is the same on every trophy. That is the point.
why_it_exists: Some things deserve a trophy and there is nobody to give you one. Give it to someone, or to yourself.
target_customer: People who want to say well done to a friend, a colleague or themselves, and do not want to write the words.

physical.form: A two-handled cup on a stem, on a square base with a front plate engraved "Well done."
materials: Cast zinc alloy cup with a gold finish
physical.dimensions: 20 cm tall x 12 cm wide x 8 cm deep

features: Every trophy is engraved with the words "Well done.", and the engraving cannot be changed.
It comes in one size, 20 cm tall, in gold.
It stands on a solid wooden base, so it feels weighty in the hand.
A soft cloth comes in the box, so you can keep it shiny.
arrives: The trophy sits in a paper-pulp cradle inside a brown card box, with no plastic. The soft cloth is folded in with it. Open the box, wipe it with the cloth and hand it over.
specs: 20 cm tall x 12 cm wide (across handles) x 8 cm deep (base)
Cast zinc alloy cup with a gold finish, solid ash base, brass-effect engraved plate
Gold cup on a pale wood base
"Well done." Fixed. Cannot be changed or added to.
Solid ash, square, about 8 x 8 cm
The Trophy and a soft cloth
Dust with the soft cloth. No polish or abrasive cleaners. Keep out of damp.
how_it_works: Put it on a shelf. Hand it to someone.

compatibility.note: The engraving is "Well done." only. We cannot add names, dates or other words.

packaging: A kraft card box with a paper-pulp cradle. No plastic.

warranty.summary: It has a 12-month warranty against faults in how it was made. Tarnish, scratches and knocks are not covered. See Warranty.

care: Do not use polish or abrasive cleaners. They remove the finish.
safety: It weighs 520 g. Keep it on a stable shelf.

delivery.note: Soon or Sooner. Soon is free over £50.

returnable.note: You can return it within 30 days if it is unused and in its box. See Returns.

page.headline: Engraved: Well done.
page.intro: Engraved "Well done." That's all it says.

sections.title: What you get
sections.body: A gold trophy cup on a solid wooden base, 20 cm tall. £24.

sections.title: The engraving
sections.body: It says "Well done." We cannot add a name, a date or anything else.

sections.title: Looking after it
sections.body: Dust it with the cloth. Do not use polish.

faq.a: No. It says "Well done." on every trophy.
No. It is a gold finish on a metal cup.
Yes, within 30 days, if it is unused and in its box. The engraving is not a reason for a refund.

faq.q: The finish has worn. Can you fix it?
faq.a: Yes. The Fix Club re-plates it. The price is quoted after assessment.

troubleshooting.problem: The finish looks dull or marked.
steps: Dust it with the soft cloth.
Do not use polish or rough cleaners.
troubleshooting.if_unresolved: The Fix Club can re-plate it. Open a support case for a quote.

troubleshooting.problem: The cup is loose on the base.
steps: Lay it on its side on a soft cloth and look at the fixing.
troubleshooting.if_unresolved: Open a support case. A loose cup is a fault under warranty.

photography_direction: Plain and proud. One trophy, centred. The engraved plate is readable. No confetti, no podium.
